item.title: Aisha Wahab wins special election to serve out remainder of Eric Swalwell's term
item.description: The partial term for California's 14th Congressional District ends January 2027, after which the candidate chosen in the November election will serve the next full term.

item.title: Medical nightmare in Tennessee hospital after drug mix-up
item.description: A dangerous drug mix-up at a Tennessee hospital left several patients badly injured this week. Nicole Valdes reports.

item.title: Video captures plane hitting Pennsylvania State Police helicopter in midair
item.description: Warning: disturbing video. A deadly collision was caught on camera in Pennsylvania on Wednesday. A small plane slammed into a state police helicopter at an airport outside the state capital of Harrisburg. Michael George reports.

item.title: Inside Disney and ABC's First Amendment rights as they sue FCC over early license renewal
item.description: Disney and ABC is suing the government over claims that it restricted its First Amendment rights by requesting early license renewals in response to content critical of the Trump administration. CBS News' legal contributor Jessica Levinson gives her analysis.

item.title: Fierce rain swamps Ohio, Kansas, Nebraska, storms hit Mid-Atlantic
item.description: A line of potentially dangerous storms slammed the Mid-Atlantic on Thursday after downpours earlier in Ohio triggered dozens of flash floods. Lonnie Quinn tracks it all.

item.title: Woman arrested for plot to blow up New York State Capitol
item.description: The FBI announced the arrest of a 35-year-old woman they said had converted to Islam, expressed support for terrorism online, and allegedly developed a plan of her own to blow up the New York State Capitol. Meg Oliver reports.

item.title: NASA calls off mission to save Swift telescope, which will plunge into Earth's atmosphere and burn
item.description: NASA is calling off a mission to save the Swift telescope, which is set to plunge into Earth's atmosphere and burn up later this year. CBS News' space consultant Bill Harwood chimes in.

item.title: Trump to rally with Darline Graham ahead of South Carolina Senate runoff
item.description: President Trump is set to rally with South Carolina Sen. Darline Graham ahead of Tuesday's special Senate runoff between Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman. CBS News' Zak Hudak has more.

item.title: Neutrogena shares statement on Hayden Panettiere after backlash
item.description: After Hayden Panettiere's death, fans resurfaced her claim that Neutrogena had fired her in 2015 over her comments about postpartum depression.

item.title: Walmart says it's using tariff refunds to lower prices as sales show slowest growth in 6 years
item.description: Walmart says it's planning to use $2.9 billion in tariff refunds to lower prices as it reports its slowest sales growth in six years. CBS News' Kelly O'Grady has more.

item.title: Pilot killed as plane collides with police helicopter at airport, officials say
item.description: One person was killed and two Pennsylvania State Police troopers were injured when a small plane collided with a state police helicopter on the ground in central Pennsylvania, authorities said.

item.title: New details revealed in Hayden Panettiere's death
item.description: The DEA has joined the investigation into actor Hayden Panettiere's sudden death over the weekend, sources say. CBS News' Mark Strassman reports.

item.title: "The Takeout" says goodbye to its original red chairs
item.description: The red chairs on "The Takeout" set, like the show, are unpretentious. But there is a season for all things, and it is now time to say goodbye. CBS News chief Washington correspondent Major Garrett bids a fond farewell to the beloved seats.

item.title: Iran dismisses Trump's "economic D-Day" threat as more "failed policies"
item.description: Iran has shrugged off President Trump's threat to hit the Islamic Republic with an "economic D-Day" as a "doubling down on failed policies."

item.title: Obama's former "body man" Reggie Love on working for the ex-president
item.description: What if you had an assistant, babysitter, lunch companion, scheduler, and friend, all in one person? Well, lawmakers have that, and they're called "body people." Reggie Love, who served as former President Barack Obama's "body man" from 2007 to 2011, joins "The Takeout" to discuss his experience.

item.title: Bessent threatens "toughest sanctions in history" on Iran
item.description: Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent says the U.S. is planning to impose devastating sanctions on Iran as war with the U.S. drags on. CBS News' Olivia Rinaldi has more on that and North Korea's launch of ballistic missiles.

item.title: Woman accused of plotting "major attack" on New York State Capitol building
item.description: A New York woman is accused of plotting "a major attack" on the state Capitol building in Albany, authorities said Thursday.

item.title: Sen. Darline Graham says she's "not that informed on national security" at debate
item.description: At a debate ahead of South Carolina's GOP Senate primary runoff, Sen. Darline Graham said she's "not that informed on national security," drawing gasps from the audience. Bloomberg White House correspondent Jeff Mason and Associated Press politics reporter Matt Brown join "The Takeout" to discuss.

item.title: FBI seizes Swalwell's devices, executes warrants in sexual misconduct probe
item.description: FBI agents executed search warrants targeting former Democratic Rep. Eric Swalwell and seized his electronic devices, two sources told CBS News.

item.title: What Prince Harry and Meghan Markle's return to U.K. could look like after years of family drama
item.description: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle are moving back to the U.K. more than six years after stepping away from their roles in the royal family and settling in California. CBS News royal contributor Amanda Foreman joins to discuss.

item.title: Democratic socialist talks agenda as she looks to unseat embattled Rep. Jimmy Gomez
item.description: The House Ethics Committee confirmed this week that it is investigating sexual misconduct allegations against Democratic Rep. Jimmy Gomez of California, who denies the claims. Angela Gonzales-Torres, a democratic socialist who is running against Gomez in California's Los Angeles-based 34th district, joins to discuss.

item.title: Trump claims North Korea has 57 nuclear weapons
item.description: North Korea on Thursday fired several short-range ballistic missiles hours after President Trump said he would meet with leader Kim Jong Un. Mr. Trump also made the claim that North Korea has 57 nuclear weapons, but that the situation is under control. Victor Cha, president of the Geopolitics and Foreign Policy Department at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, joins with analysis.

item.title: Lindsay Clancy murder trial closing arguments expected early next week
item.description: Testimony at Lindsay Clancy's trial ended early Thursday as closing arguments are expected next week.

item.title: Trump administration pressuring countries to cut economic ties with Iran
item.description: President Trump is threatening to put more economic pressure on Iran. CBS News chief White House correspondent Nancy Cordes reports. Then, Matthew Kroenig, senior fellow at the Atlantic Council, joins with analysis.

item.title: Invasive Joro spiders "may be hanging on a web near you": Here's what to know
item.description: The invasive Joro spider is popping up again around several U.S. states. Researchers say they are essentially harmless to humans, here's what you should know.

item.title: On the ground in Kyiv after latest wave of Russian strikes
item.description: Russia launched a drone attack on Kyiv overnight Wednesday into Thursday, killing at least 16 people and wounding 40 more. These videos show the moment strikes hit the Ukrainian capital and the damage after.

item.title: 8/20: The Takeout with Major Garrett
item.description: U.S. national debt hits record $40 trillion, doubling in less than 10 years; Trump administration pressuring countries to cut economic ties with Iran.

item.title: Invasive Joro spiders are "slowly spreading." Here's what to do if you see one.
item.description: The Great Smoky Mountains National Park told visitors Tuesday that invasive Joro spiders "may be hanging in a web near you."

item.title: NASA's Swift telescope will plunge toward Earth after rescue mission called off
item.description: The mission to save NASA's sinking space telescope has been called off, dooming the telescope to a fiery reentry later this year.

item.title: Darline Graham says she's "not that informed on national security" at debate
item.description: The Republican nominee for the South Carolina Senate seat will be determined in the runoff between Sen. Darline Graham and Rep. Ralph Norman on Aug. 25.
